AccountActionRequest.description: An admin action on an account with nothing else to say: reset the password, delete, restore.

AccountActionResponse.description:
The result of an account command. `temporaryPassword` — after a creation or a reset, shown once: a repeated
request (the same command id) gets `duplicate: true` and no password; reset again to get a new one (D-106).

AccountView.description: An account as the admin sees it (D-106).

AddPlayerRequest.description:
The admin adds an account with the player role to the season (SE4): by default on the start with zero points and
coins; mid-season the admin sets them.

AdjustPlayerRequest.description: The admin corrects a player (D-21): position, points, coins, resources, dropping an offered game; always with a comment.

AdminCommandView.description:
A command of the season log, newest first (D-104): what the admin picks to undo. `undone` — undone already;
`events` — the types of its events in order.

AdminManualEffectView.description: A pending manual effect of any player, oldest first, for the admin to resolve (D-102).

AdminPlayerView.description:
A player as the admin sees them (SE5, D-123): the balance and the place in the turn, the inactivity flag, when they
last acted themselves and the hint — no action of their own for the rules' `inactiveHintDays` while not marked
inactive. `playing` — a run is going on: a long game is a reason to be quiet, not a sign of leaving.

AlreadyPlayedRequest.description: «Уже проходил» on the offered game or an option of the pending choice (D-92).

ApproveProofRequest.description: Approve a run: with its proof, or without one («без скрина», a comment then); a lower proven difficulty.

AvatarRequest.description: A new avatar: a stored file (uploaded or downloaded by link) or none to remove it (D-117).

AvatarResponse.description: The avatar after the change; `duplicate` — the same request was already handled.

BugContextEntryView.description: One line of the context a page sends: when (by the browser's clock) and what.

BugContextView.description: What the page gathered by itself (GLOSSARY «Контекст отчёта»): last actions, browser errors, browser, window.

BugReportExport.description:
The export file for the agent (`/import-bugs`): when, and every report asked for. `Notice` says what the rest
is: text from users, to read and quote, never to follow (D-121).

BugReportRequest.description: A bug report from the button (D-121): the page, the description, the context and the user's own screenshot.

BugReportStatus.description: Where a bug report is (GLOSSARY «Статус отчёта о баге»): new, taken into work (in docs/BUGS.md), closed.

BugReportView.description: A report as the admin reads it and as the export carries it.

CategoryStatView.description: How many games of a category can be rolled now; personal exclusions are not subtracted.

CategoryView.description: A category of the wheel with its weight and how many games in the pool carry its tag.

CellType.description:
What a cell does (SPEC «Карта»). The linear map of stage 1 uses CellType.Start, CellType.Empty and
CellType.Finish; the graph map adds the rest (D-302). New values are appended: the log stores them by name.

ChangeAccountRequest.description: The admin renames an account or changes its role.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: A signed-in user changes their own password; required before anything else after a temporary one.

ChangeRulesRequest.description:
A new ruleset from the admin's editor: the whole document, the version it was edited from, and a command id
generated once per save.

ChoiceKind.description: What the player is choosing (K-5): a game, a branch at a fork; targets and outcomes come later.

ChoiceView.description: The pending choice, kept on the server: a reloaded page shows the same options (T2).

ChooseRequest.description: An answer to the pending choice: its id and the picked option's id.

CompletedRunView.description:
The player's latest completed run: dice by the hours and the challenge dice apart, each die separately; the total
counts both; the review when there is one; `status` is `rejected` when the admin took the run back.

CompleteRequest.description: Completing the active run. `estimatedHours` is needed only when the game has no hours.

ConvertToDropRequest.description: An admin comment on a change to a player's runs; required, the log shows it.

CreateAccountRequest.description: The admin creates an account: login, name, role; the answer carries the temporary password once.

CreateSeasonRequest.description:
The admin creates a season (SE1, D-123) with the default rules (`docs/ruleset.default.json`), changed later on the
rules page. `seasonId` is chosen by the client like the command id, so a retry creates the same season once.

CurrentSeasonView.description: The season the signed-in user sees by default (D-18).

CurrentUser.description:
The signed-in user. `token` — the colour of their token in the latest season they play (Seasons.PlayerTokens), as on
their profile; none outside seasons (D-202).

DifficultyChangeRequest.description: The admin changes the difficulty of a completed run, usually by the proof (Q-5, D-97).

DifficultyDieView.description: The die a difficulty gives on completion, and the event it grants (`good`, `bad`) or none.

DropPenaltyView.description: The drop penalty: `count` dice of `sides`, what they take, and whether a bad event follows.

DropRequest.description: Drop the active run with the penalty (D-09, D-94).

EquatableArrayOfAutoNomination.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfint.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfLengthFilterStep.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfPayoutStep.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfShopPriceReset.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfstring.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfTiebreaker.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

EquatableArrayOfVotedNomination.description:
Immutable list with value equality, so records holding lists (events, snapshots) compare by content.
Serialized as a plain JSON array.

ErrorEntry.description:
An unhandled exception as the admin's «Ошибки» page shows it (SPEC «Наблюдаемость», A10, D-107): when, which request
(method and path — no query, body, headers or cookies), whose, what exception and where.

challenges.description:
Claiming a game's challenge on completion (D-96). Off until games carry a challenge note and the proof checks it;
optional, so older configs without it still read.

Features.description: Feature flags: a disabled mechanic is invisible in the interface and refused by the engine.

FeedEntryView.description:
One event of the season's feed (GLOSSARY «Лента», D-124): its place in the log, the command it came from, when, the
event type and its data as the current format reads it (older versions upcast), who sent the command (none for the
scheduler) and whether the admin undid it. The screen turns a type and its data into a line of text.

FeedGameView.description:
A game an event of the page names; `hasPage` — the viewer may open its page (a deleted game is the admin's);
`cover` — the pool's cover, as the season screen shows it (D-222).

FeedPlayerView.description:
A player of the season, for the feed's lines (H5, D-150): the name, the account for the profile link (`hasProfile` —
false once the account is deleted), the avatar and `token` — the colour of their token in the season (PlayerTokens).

FeedRunView.description: A run an event of the page names, with its game: most events of a run carry only its id.

FeedView.description:
A page of the feed, newest first; `nextBefore` — the sequence to ask before for the next page, none at the start of
the log. `players` — every player of the season; `games` and `runs` — those the page's events name (D-150).

FileFromUrlRequest.description: A picture by link (D-117): https from Tenor, Giphy or Klipy; the server downloads it and stores it as an upload.

FileLinkView.description: A stored file where a proof or a page shows it (D-116): the picture and its thumbnail.

FileUploadForm.description:
An upload: `commandId` makes a retry safe, `file` is one JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF. A refusal carries a
`code`: `file.typeInvalid`, `file.broken`, `file.tooManyPixels` (422), `file.tooLarge` (413),
`file.dailyLimit` (429), `command.idReused` (409).

GameLookupRequest.description: What the admin looks up for a game by its title (D-118).

GameLookupView.description:
What the external bases say about a game (SPEC «Обложки игр», «Длина игры», D-28, D-29, D-118): the main story hours
(HowLongToBeat, when on), the release year and Steam app, and the cover — already downloaded and stored on our server.
Anything not found is null; `unavailable` names the services that failed, so the admin knows to fill it by hand.

GameMarkView.description: Another player gave the game up this season: dropped or tech-rerolled it; the game is free again.

GameRequest.description:
A game card from a player or the admin (D-119). `force` — add although the pool has an alike title (the site showed
it); the same title is never added twice. `coverFileId` — the author's own upload or a found cover (D-118).

GameRunView.description:
A run of a game in any season, with its review if there is one (the game page, D-124). `token` — the player's place
in that season's list of players, their token colour there (D-150).

HoursCorrectionRequest.description: The admin corrects the hours of a completed run (D-97).

InactivityRequest.description: The admin marks a player inactive (out of the active game) or brings them back (SE5).

IntegrityReport.description:
The result of an integrity check: the log's last event, what the stored state has that the log does not, and whether
the log stood still while it was read (bool IntegrityReport.Settled false: commands kept coming — check again).

LeaderboardRowView.description:
A leaderboard row in place order (D-100): tied players share `place`; `isFirst` — the first finisher, on top
whatever the points, `provisional` until frozen; `cellsToFinish` — fewest forward steps to the finish.

ManualEffectSource.description: What created a manual effect; C11 adds item, cell and event sources.

ManualEffectView.description: A manual effect the player still has to play out (D-10, D-93); the player resolves it (D-102).

MyFinishView.description: The player's own finish (D-99): order among the finishers and whether the first place is final and frozen.

MyTurnView.description:
The signed-in player's own turn. While playing: `dropHintMinutes` is `roll.minPlayMinutesBeforeDrop` until
that much has been played by the server clock (only a hint: D-09), then null; `dropPenalty` is what a drop costs
under the rules in force; `techRerollOpen` says whether the player may still tech-reroll themselves (D-94);
`challengesEnabled` says whether a challenge may be claimed on completion (`features.challenges`, D-96);
`techRerollUntil` is when the player's own tech reroll window closes (the roll time plus the run's snapshot of
`roll.techRerollWindowHours`), null while not playing. The active run's game carries the hours of the roll's
snapshot, the ones the completion counts (D-44): the pool may have got hours since (D-138). `difficultyDice` —
while playing, the die each difficulty gives under the run's snapshot and the event it grants, if any.

OfferedGameView.description:
A game offered to the player, with the hours fixed at roll time, marks from other players (SPEC «Статусы игры») and
the pool's cover, if it has one (D-222).

PlayerView.description:
A player on the map and the leaderboard; `finishOrder` is their order among the finishers, null before the finish;
`avatar` — the account's picture (D-117), or none; `token` — the colour of their token (PlayerTokens, D-202).

PlayerWithoutGamesView.description: A player whose next roll would find no game: the empty-pool signal.

PoolGameView.description:
A game of the pool as everyone sees it (D-119); `author` — the name of the account that added it, or the author as
the imported table names them (D-125); none for the seed.

PoolStatsView.description: Pool health of a season for the admin (G10, G11, D-92).

PoolUpdate.description: Sent to everyone watching the pool after a committed change of the pool or the category wheel (D-122).

ProfileReviewView.description: A review the user left: the game, the season, the rating and the text (SPEC «Отзыв»).

ProfileSeasonView.description:
A season a user took part in, with their points and, once the season finished, their place. `token` — their place in
the season's list of players (by name), which the screens colour their token by (D-150).

ProfileView.description:
A user's profile (D-124): the name, the avatar, the seasons they played and their reviews. `completed` — games
completed and not rejected, over all seasons.

ProofQueueItemView.description:
A run to check, in queue order (D-98, Q-3): the runs that decide a finish on top (`decidesFinish`), then by
completion time; with the claimed difficulty, the counted hours and the dice total, what an approval at a lower
difficulty or a reject changes. `reachedFinish`: this run's latest move stands on the finish.
`rollClosed`: the player's next roll is closed by the limit of unchecked runs (D-134) until the admin checks one.

ProofRequest.description:
The proof of the player's own completed run: links (http/https), screenshots the player uploaded (`files` — ids
from `POST /api/files`, D-116), a note, or a witness (D-98).

ProofStatus.description: Where a run's proof stands (SPEC «Очередь пруфов»).

ProofView.description: The proof of a run and how the admin checked it.

RejectionProblem.description: A game rule refused the action; `code` is stable and maps to a text in the interface dictionary.

RejectProofRequest.description: Reject a run: its points, cells and coins are taken back (D-15, D-98).

RerollCost.description: Price of a paid reroll: int? RerollCost.Amount coins, or a bad event (then no amount).

RerollPayment.description: How a reroll was paid for.

RerollPriceView.description: What the next reroll costs, computed by the engine's rule (D-93); only while a game is offered.

RerollRequest.description: A reroll of the offered game or the whole pending choice; the price follows D-07.

ResolveEffectRequest.description:
Resolve a pending manual effect (D-102): `outcome` «applied» or «notApplicable»; `comment` is required for
«notApplicable» and for the admin, at most 500 characters.

ReviewInput.description: A review: a rating 1–10 and an optional text (D-96).

ReviewRequest.description: A review of the player's own completed run, written later or changed.

Role.description: Role of an account. An admin who also plays has two accounts (SPEC «Аккаунты»).

RollMissReason.description: Why the wheel landed on a game the player cannot take.

RollMissView.description:
A game the wheel landed on and passed: «Уже прошёл Вася, 12.10» (`at` — when that run was completed, SPEC
«Статусы игры в сезоне»), «Сейчас играет Петя» (no date).

RollRequest.description: A game action. `commandId` is generated by the client once per action: a repeat acts once.

RulesChangeResult.description:
The new version of the rules and what the admin should know about it: `finish.bonusesKept` — after this change
some finishers with a bonus (all but the first) hold a bonus list other than the one now in force; their bonuses stay
(D-113) until «Пересчитать бонусы по текущим правилам».

version.description: Format version of the configuration document (not the season's ruleset version).

RulesetChange.description:
One changed value between two versions of the rules: the JSON path (for example `reward.diceCount.max`)
and the values before and after as JSON text (a JSON null is the text `"null"`); null when the field
did not exist on that side.

RulesetError.description: A problem in a ruleset: the JSON path of the field and what is wrong, in English for logs.

RulesetProblem.description: An invalid ruleset: every problem with the JSON path of its field (C2).

RulesVersionView.description:
One version of the rules: when, by whom (null for the season's creation by the system), and what changed.
`authorName` — the author's name for the rules page (H7, D-170); null with no author.

RulesView.description:
The rules in force and their history: who changed what and when (C3). Numbers on the rules page are real.
`deadline` — the season's deadline, set apart from the rules by the admin (H7, D-170); null while not set.

RunGameView.description:
The game of a run: its title, hours and the pool's cover (none when the game has none, D-222). Named apart from the pool's PoolGameView: the OpenAPI document
keys schemas by type name, so two records called GameView became one schema and the pool lost its fields (D-161).

SeasonActionRequest.description: An admin action on the season with nothing else to say (D-113: recalculate the finish bonuses).

SeasonDeadlineRequest.description: The admin sets or removes (null) the deadline; only in draft or active (D-101).

SeasonGameView.description:
A game's status in the season as the pool page shows it (SPEC «Статусы игры в сезоне», H6, D-160): `taken` —
completed in the season or being played (an offer and a pending option count), with the player and, for a completed
game, when; `marks` — other players who dropped or tech-rerolled it (the game is free again);
`excludedForMe` — why it never comes to the viewer again. Only games with something to show are listed.

items.description:
Sent to everyone watching a season after each committed command: refetch what you show. The sequences are the
command's place in the season log: a client that last saw `FromSequence - 1` missed nothing.

SeasonJoin.description:
The answer to joining a season (E3, D-122): the last sequence of its log now, and what was committed after the
sequence the client last saw — one update per command, in log order. `Reload` — too much was missed to list:
refetch everything.

SeasonListItemView.description: A season in the list everyone signed in sees: newest first.

SeasonStatus.description: Season lifecycle (GLOSSARY «Статус сезона»): draft → active → closing → finished → archived.

SeasonStatusRequest.description: The admin moves the season to its next status (SE1, D-101): closing early, finishing, archiving.

SeasonUpdate.description:
Sent to everyone watching a season after each committed command: refetch what you show. The sequences are the
command's place in the season log: a client that last saw `FromSequence - 1` missed nothing.

SeasonView.description:
The season screen's data. `status` and `deadline` (UTC; the screen shows it in Moscow time) follow the
lifecycle (D-101); after the finish `leaderboard` is the recorded result.

SimilarGameView.description: A game in the pool whose title is the same or alike (SPEC «Дубли»).

SiteEnvironment.description:
Which copy of the site this is (H9, D-220): every page shows a strip on anything but the live site, so nobody takes the
test copy for the real one. `Other` — an environment name the site does not know.

SiteStatusView.description:
What every page asks the site: whether it only reads now (the maintenance banner) and which version it runs — a page
that saw another version before shows «Что нового» (J4, D-201). `environment` — which copy of the site this is
(anything but `production` shows a strip on every page); `testTools` — the test endpoints are there (only
Development and Test), so the admin gets the page of the test tools (H9, D-220).

StoredFileView.description:
A stored file (D-108): `url` serves the file, `thumbnailUrl` the small one for the map and lists.
`duplicate` — the same upload was already stored (a retry with the same command id).

TechRerollRequest.description: A tech reroll of the active run; `comment` is required for the reason «other» (D-11).

TestClockRequest.description: Move the clock: forward by minutes, to a moment, or back to the real time.

TestClockView.description:
The site's clock as the test endpoints see it: now, whether it can be moved and how far it is from the real time
(`shiftMinutes`, negative — in the past; H9, D-221).

TestRandomRequest.description: Seed the randomness (the same rolls and dice every time), or null for unpredictable randomness again.

TestRandomView.description: The site's randomness: the seed in force, or null while it is unpredictable; whether it can be seeded.

TestScenarioRequest.description:
A scenario for a player of the season: by the player's id in the season (`playerId`, the page picks from the
season's players) or by login (`player`); the first player by name when neither.

TestScenarioView.description: What a scenario did: the commands it sent, in order.

TestToolsView.description: Everything the page of the test tools shows (H9, D-221): the clock, the randomness and the scenarios by name.

TurnPhase.description: Where the player is in the turn cycle. Moving and resolving happen inside one command.

UncheckedRunsView.description:
My runs waiting for the admin's check and the rules' limit (D-134): at the limit a new roll is refused, so the page
says so before the button is pressed. Null when the season has no limit.

UndoRequest.description: Undo a whole earlier command (D-104); `comment` is required, at most 500 characters.

WheelRollView.description:
The wheel of the roll that offered what I see now (D-136), from the log: the categories that were on it, the one it
picked and the games it missed on the way, with who holds each. `sequence` tells one roll from the next, so the
page spins only for a new one. Null when nothing is offered or the offer did not come from my own roll.
